description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for CRUD operations and API documentation (Swagger) for the LLM cost records endpoint. It sets up routes for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting LLM cost documents, utilizing a controller built via a factory method and referencing the LLM cost model.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list LLM cost records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination, using controller's list method.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific LLM cost record by ID, using controller's getById method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new LLM cost record, using controller's create method.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing LLM cost record identified by ID, using controller's update method.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a specific LLM cost record by ID, using controller's remove method.
